name: skills_list
description: List user and featured office skills from the app's own skills endpoint, replayed in the logged-in page context; runtimeType defaults to the observed library-page value 2.

runtimeType.description: runtime_type observed values: 2 = skill library page, 1 = inside a session (unverified variant)

execution.expression: async (input) => { const r=await fetch('https://www.doubao.com/alice/office/skills/list_user_and_featured?version_code=20800&language=zh&device_platform=web&doubao_device_platform=desktop',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},credentials:'include',body:JSON.stringify({runtime_type:Number.isInteger(input&&input.runtimeType)?input.runtimeType:2})}); const b=await r.json().catch(()=>null); const d=b&&b.data; const skills=(d&&Array.isArray(d.skills)?d.skills:[]).slice(0,200).map(s=>({name:String(s.name||'').slice(0,120),displayName:String(s.display_name||'').slice(0,160),description:String(s.display_description||s.description||'').slice(0,300),externalSkillId:String(s.external_skill_id||'').slice(0,120),categories:(Array.isArray(s.categories)?s.categories:[]).slice(0,5).map(c=>String(c.category_name||'').slice(0,80)),recommend:s.recommend===true,type:Number.isInteger(s.type)?s.type:null,visible:s.visible===true})); return {httpStatus:r.status,code:Number.isInteger(b&&b.code)?b.code:null,hasMore:d?d.has_more===true:null,skillCount:skills.length,truncated:(d&&Array.isArray(d.skills)?d.skills.length:0)>200,skills}; }
